tldr: Two independent original samples yield finite-sample full-class \(90\%\) honest connected intervals for point CATE under a full unknown complex ordinary-smooth error operator. For each public \(11/2<s\le16\), \(\alpha=2\), and \(m\ge\lceil n^{1/4}\rceil\), the adaptive attainment and uniform honest frontier theorems prove sharp worst-class expected length \(a_n+m^{-1/2}\) and sharp cancellation-witness length \(a_n+1/m\), where \(a_n=n^{-s/(2s+5)}\), without local-gradient consistency. Their budget elbows are \(m\asymp n^{2s/(2s+5)}\) and \(m\asymp n^{s/(2s+5)}\), respectively. The joint moment certificate, uniform retained expansion and local Gaussian-plus-quadratic law are proved, including the raw empirical diagonal. The distinct local-limit transition is \(m\asymp\sigma_n^{-1}\); \(\sigma_n\) is not claimed minimax. The marked Hölder class has only the strict projection inclusion \(\Pi(\mathcal M_s)\subsetneq\mathcal J\) into the Johannes--Schwarz density class. The accepted positioning is field-level. The inaccessible Nshimiyimana--Qiu--Zhou theorem remains an unresolved external collision priority.
